g.title: b2_overview
g.text: B-2: the side-car's hidden layer into the module that makes the proposals, the planner downstream fine-tuned
grey: the release, frozen · blue: the side-car and what it hands over · green: trains, and starts at zero (step 0 is the release)

g.title: sidecar
g.text: the same ViT tokens, before the projector
fold k: the one that never saw this row's log

g.title: refiner
g.text: each pass decodes 32 proposals × 8 poses (4 s),
then a BEVFormer layer: self-attention and

g.title: scorer
g.text: max over each proposal's 8 poses, an MLP: 6 logits
B-2-2 and B-2-3 add a pass-4 copy of the read

g.title: adapter
g.text: before every BEVFormer layer, on all 4 passes:
each of the 256 pose-queries attends to the arm's tokens
and adds δ to itself · its output layer starts at zero
its own half (query + pose) runs in every arm, C included

g.title: pick
g.text: the highest final score: one 4 s plan

g.title: recipes
g.text: trajectory + final score on online PDM labels + its collision-agent
and area auxiliaries; the adapter and both LoRAs train together
→ dump and label the 32 → scorer LoRA + a pass-4 copy of the read
as B-2-2, the weights themselves trained

g.title: arms
g.text: the arms: what each hands the refiner
the ceiling: run first, a gate
D + each kept agent's slot a₆

g.title: decoded
g.text: the heads on a₆: class · box · velocity · 1 s path
